testcase.name: Scenario: Open a drawing with updates deferred: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-document-opening-source/features/application/document-opening/document-opening.feature:188:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Open a drawing with updates deferred ✔ Given writable copies of `fixtures/cad/document-opening/OpenDrawingA.odd`, `OpenDrawingB.odd` and `OpenPart.opd` are staged in the same working folder ✔ And the user opens each drawing, inserts a base view referencing the staged OpenPart.opd, saves it and closes it ✔ Given a part document is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a saved drawing with a sheet, border and views is available and not already open ✔ And the deferred-update information message is enabled ✔ And `OpenPart.opd` is active and the closed `OpenDrawingA.odd` drawing is available ✔ When the user opens the drawing's file selection dialog ✔ And the user selects the drawing and enable Load in Defer Mode ✔ And the user chooses Open ✔ Then an information message states that drawing updates are deferred ✔ And it indicates that defer status must change to update views and associate added annotations ✔ And the message offers a display preference and an OK control ✔ When the user acknowledges the message ✔ Then the drawing opens in a new active document tab ✔ And the sheet, border and saved view geometry are displayed ✔ And the drawing browser shows the sheet and a view ✔ And drawing view creation commands in the ribbon are unavailable ✔ And the original part tab remains available
